description: Set the colour controls of the interface: which of fill or stroke is active and whether formatting affects the container or the text (Tools panel fill/stroke proxy), the Swatches panel view (Name, Small Name, Small Swatch, Large Swatch) and Show/Hide Options, and the Color panel's Lab, CMYK or RGB sliders and Show/Hide Options

active.description: Which of fill or stroke colour changes apply to (Toggle Fill and Stroke)

affects.description: Formatting Affects Container or Formatting Affects Text

colorPanelMode.description: Color panel menu: show Lab, CMYK or RGB sliders

toggleColorOptions.description: Color panel menu > Show/Hide Options (toggles; the result gives the command's new title)

toggleSwatchesOptions.description: Swatches panel menu > Show/Hide Options (toggles; the result gives the command's new title)

name: set_color_panel_options
title: Set Color Panel Options
